realisticterrain.customize.title: Realistic Terrain Settings
realisticterrain.setting.mountain_height: Overall height of folded mountain ranges.
realisticterrain.setting.mountain_freque: How often mountain ranges appear across the world.
realisticterrain.setting.ridge_sharpness: How sharp and narrow the ridgelines are.
realisticterrain.setting.erosion_intensi: Strength of hydraulic erosion and gully carving. Zero disables the pass entirely.
realisticterrain.setting.river_width.too: Physical width of river channels, in blocks.
realisticterrain.setting.river_frequency: Spacing of the drainage network before discharge is applied.
realisticterrain.setting.river_depth.too: Incision depth of river channels and ocean trenches.
realisticterrain.setting.snow_line.toolt: Base altitude of permanent snow, before climate and slope bias it.
realisticterrain.setting.biome_scale.too: Size of temperature and humidity zones.
realisticterrain.setting.sea_level.toolt: Water level of the world's oceans.
realisticterrain.setting.roughness.toolt: Fine terrain roughness and cave threshold variation.
realisticterrain.setting.vegetation_dens: Density of slope- and soil-aware forests. Zero plants no trees.
realisticterrain.setting.continental_sca: Size of continents and ocean basins.
realisticterrain.setting.canyon_depth.to: Incision of fluvial canyons into plateaus.
realisticterrain.setting.coast_line.tool: Continentalness at the shoreline: lower means more land, higher means more ocean.
realisticterrain.setting.ocean_depth.too: How far the abyssal plain sits below sea level.
realisticterrain.setting.maximum_terrain: Highest ground the generator may write, kept below the build ceiling so snow, trees and structures still fit.
realisticterrain.setting.plate_scale.too: Size of tectonic plates. Larger plates mean longer, straighter ranges.
realisticterrain.setting.tectonic_activi: How much uplift, rifting and faulting the plate margins produce.
realisticterrain.setting.mountain_range_: Width of the folded belt either side of a convergent margin.
realisticterrain.setting.mountain_uplift: Broad regional uplift applied under a mountain range.
realisticterrain.setting.river_density.t: Number of drainage networks. Zero generates no rivers at all.
realisticterrain.setting.tributary_densi: How readily small tributaries are cut into the main channels.
realisticterrain.setting.meander_strengt: Lateral wandering of a river's course. Never lets the water flow uphill.
How many closed drainage basins fill with lakes.
realisticterrain.setting.wetland_frequen: How often flat, poorly drained ground becomes wetland.
Size of the drainage regions the flow network is solved over.
realisticterrain.setting.cave_generation: Density of mountain caves. Zero disables cave carving and its water pockets.
realisticterrain.setting.generate_struct: Whether structures such as villages and temples may generate in this world.
